pages.en:
“——”

Everyone stares at the sight in stunned disbelief.

Not only Tohsaka and me.

Even Caster, who should be exulting in victory, can only gape at her own Master.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
Everyone watches it in astonishment.
Not just me and Tohsaka.
Even Caster, who should be overwhelmed with victory, watches her master in astonishment.

pages.ja:
セイバーの速攻から葛木の反撃。
悪夢のような首打ちから、敵である俺たちでさえ見惚れるほど、見事すぎた一投まで。
pages.jaRuby:
セイバーの速攻から葛木の反撃。
悪夢のような首打ちから、敵である俺たちでさえ見惚れるほど、見事すぎた一投まで。
pages.en:
Saber's lightning assault. Kuzuki's counterattack.

From that nightmarish strike to her throat to the final, magnificent throw—so perfect that even we, his enemies, could not help but marvel at it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saber’s quick charge to Kuzuki’s counter-attacks…
From the nightmare-like neck grab, to the perfect throw that fascinated even us.

pages.ja:
「
」
セイバーは動かない。
首を掴まれたまま投げられ、背中から壁に激突した。
首の傷はおそらく致命傷。
加えて、トドメとばかりにあのスピードで壁に叩きつけられたのだ。

pages.en:
“——”

Saber does not move.

He seized her by her wounded throat and hurled her back-first into the wall.

The wound to her neck is almost certainly fatal. And then, as if to finish the job, he hurled her into the wall at that speed.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
Saber doesn’t move.
She was thrown by her neck and smashed back first into the wall.
The wound on her neck should be fatal.
Even worse, she hit the wall with such speed.

pages.ja:
即死、という訳ではなさそうだが、動く事は出来まい。
少なくとも、首の傷と全身の打撲が癒えるまでセイバーは地面に倒れたままだろう
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
—She does not appear to have died instantly, but she cannot possibly move.

Until the wound to her throat and the damage across her body have healed, Saber will lie helpless upon the ground—
pages.mirrorMoon:
I don’t think it killed her, but I’m sure she won’t be able to move.
At the very least, Saber will stay on the ground until the wounds on her neck and body heal.

pages.ja:
「そんな、ばかな」
知らず声が漏れる。
拳をキャスターの魔術で強化されているといっても、葛木は生身の人間にすぎない。
それがまさか、格闘戦でサーヴァントを圧倒するなど誰が思おう。
pages.jaRuby:
「そんな、ばかな」
知らず声が漏れる。

pages.en:
“That's… impossible.”

The words escape me before I know it.

Caster may have reinforced his fists with her magecraft, but Kuzuki is still only human flesh and blood.

Who could ever have imagined that he would overwhelm a Servant in hand-to-hand combat?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“No… way…”
I murmur without realizing.
Even though his fists are strengthened using Caster’s magic, Kuzuki is only human.
Who could possibly think that he would be able to overwhelm a Servant in hand-to-hand combat?

pages.ja:
「マスターの役割は後方支援などと決めつけるのはいいがな」
振り返る痩躯。
「例外はつねに存在する。私のように、前に出るしか能のないマスターもいるという事だ」
pages.jaRuby:
「マスターの役割は後方支援などと決めつけるのはいいがな」
振り返る痩躯。
「例外はつねに存在する。私のように、前に出るしか能のないマスターもいるという事だ」
pages.en:
“You may insist that a Master's place is in the rear, providing support.”

The gaunt man turns toward us.

“But there are always exceptions. Some Masters, like me, are good for nothing but standing at the front.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It is fine to assume that the Master’s role is to support the battle from the back.”
The lean figure turns.
“But there are always exceptions. There are Masters who can only fight head on.”

pages.ja:
それは、たった今見せつけられた。
つまり、この二人は。
後方支援と戦闘担当、その役割がまったくの逆なのか………！
pages.jaRuby:
それは、たった今見せつけられた。
つまり、この二人は。
[ruby text=マスター o2o=1]後方支援と[ruby text=サーヴァント char=4]戦闘担当、その役割がまったくの逆なのか………！
pages.en:
He has just demonstrated the truth of that.

Ordinarily, the Master provides support from the rear while the Servant does the fighting. With these two, the roles are completely reversed…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
He just proved that to us.
So…
Their roles as the one to fight and one to support are reversed…!

pages.ja:
「何をしているキャスター。事前に言っておいただろう。
後方支援をするのなら、敵の飛び道具は始末しておけと」
pages.jaRuby:
「何をしているキャスター。事前に言っておいただろう。
後方支援をするのなら、敵の飛び道具は始末しておけと」
pages.en:
“What are you doing, Caster? I told you beforehand.

“If you intend to support me from the rear, dispose of the enemy's projectiles.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What are you doing, Caster? I told you earlier.
If you are to support me, you are to eliminate the enemy’s projectile weapons.”

だから葛木は俺たちを狙わない。
魔術師の相手は魔術師にさせるのが確実なのだと、あいつは肌で感じ取っている。

pages.en:
The enemy—Kuzuki—fixes his gaze upon Tohsaka.

To him, the threat is not Saber, but Tohsaka and her ability to attack at range.

That is why Kuzuki does not come after us himself.

He understands instinctively that the surest course is to have one mage deal with another.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The enemyKuzuki stares at Tohsaka.
A threat to him would not be Saber, but Tohsaka, who is able to attack from a distance.
That’s why he won’t attack us.
He fully knows that letting a magus fight a magus would be the most sure way to a kill.

“—No. I shall dispose of Saber myself. Souichirou, you take the remaining Masters.”

“——”

“What’s wrong, Caster? I told you that you can do as you wish.”

pages.ja:
キャスターの提案に無言で頷き、葛木は俺たちへと足を向ける。
その背後で、キャスターは倒れ伏したセイバーへと向き直った。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Kuzuki acknowledges Caster's proposal with a silent nod and turns his steps toward us.

Behind him, Caster faces the place where Saber lies crumpled against the wall.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Kuzuki silently nods and walks toward us.
Caster faces Saber behind him.

pages.ja:
「
上等。セイバーは面食らってやられたけど、あいつのネタは判ってる。要は近づかれる前に倒せばいいんでしょ」
pages.jaRuby:
「
上等。セイバーは面食らってやられたけど、あいつのネタは判ってる。要は近づかれる前に倒せばいいんでしょ」
pages.en: “—Fine by me. Saber was caught off guard, but now I know his trick. All I have to do is put him down before he gets close, right?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Fine. Saber was taken aback, but I already know his attacks. We just have to beat him before he gets close to us.”

pages.ja:
葛木を睨みつけたまま、遠坂はじりじりと後退していく。
魔術師と戦士の戦いは距離との戦いだ。
いかに化け物じみた格闘技能をもっていようが、葛木に対魔力はない。

pages.en:
Tohsaka glares at Kuzuki as she slowly yields ground.

—A battle between mage and warrior is a battle over distance.

However monstrous Kuzuki's fighting technique may be, he possesses no Magic Resistance.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Tohsaka slowly retreats while glaring at Kuzuki.
A battle between a magus and a fighter is a fight for distance.
Even though Kuzuki has monstrous fighting techniques, he has no magic resistance.

pages.ja:
故に、放てば勝てる。
近づかれる前に一つでも呪文を編み上げられればこちらの勝ちだ。
pages.jaRuby:
故に、放てば勝てる。
近づかれる前に一つでも呪文を編み上げられればこちらの勝ちだ。
pages.en:
And so, if she can fire, she wins.

If she completes even a single spell before he closes the distance, victory is ours.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Therefore, we can win if we cast something.
We win if we manage to cast a spell before he reaches us.
